en: Dependent on a state that is *saraṇa* (with conflict) and fixed in the wrongness, a state that is *na-saraṇa* (without conflict) and not fixed in the wrongness arises by way of root condition. [Under] root [condition], one; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance, one.

Dependent on a state that is *araṇa* (without conflict) and fixed in the rightness, a state that is *na-saraṇa* (without conflict) and not fixed in the rightness arises by way of root condition. [Under] root [condition], one; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance, one.

Dependent on a state that is *araṇa* (without conflict) and undetermined, a state that is *na-araṇa* (not without conflict) and not undetermined arises by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a state that is *araṇa*...

Conditioned by a state that is indeterminate (aniyata), a state that is neither subject to cankers nor indeterminate arises by way of root-condition (hetu-paccaya). Under root-condition there are two; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance-condition (avigata) there are two.
